title: Ghormeh sabzi
description: A traditional Persian herb stew made with a mix of sautéed herbs, kidney beans, and lamb or beef, served over rice.
instructions: Soak the kidney beans in water overnight or for at least 2 hours.
Chop the herbs and sauté them in a large pot with some oil until they are wilted.
Add the chopped onion, turmeric and fenugreek leaves and cook until golden brown.
In a separate pan, add the meat and fry until browned on all sides.
Combine the sealed meat with the sautéed herbs in the large pot.
Add kidney beans and enough water to cover the ingredients.
Make small cuts in the dried limes with a knife. Add the dried limes, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1-2 hours until the meat is tender.
